context: Request: deals over $1B in guaranteed (base) consideration, excluding earnout/CVR value, that were governed by Delaware law. Rubric: 1001-00004 (Ardent / Luminex), 1003-00003 (Harrowgate / VeloPay), 1038-00009 (Cascade / NovaMart), 1041-00003 (Solara / Cloudium), plus a precision criterion.

divergence: Mixed outcomes. All runs ran store-wide extraction scans that timed out. T2 then searched file names for agreement types, read 22 executed agreements and ran a clause extraction over all of them, which reached all four deals. T0's amount index listed all four but the matters it chose to list left one out, and it also asserted a non-qualifying deal; T1's counts listed all four but it read other matters' agreements and answered with one deal. The split is at the step after the scans where each run chose which agreements to open (T2 stage 7-8 vs T0 stage 6, T1 stage 7); reviews at that point gave all runs similar generic warnings about unopened matters.
